summary: SDGR is a Big-4-audited (KPMG since 2010), no-going-concern, well-capitalized ($436M cash at 3/31/2024) computational-chemistry+drug-discovery business whose -57.8% drawdown is NOT a solvency or audit-walk story. It is a story of growth-thesis collapse INSIDE the cutoff window. The 10-K (Feb 28, 2024) anchors investors on a +20%/+31% multi-year top-line, +17% software growth, +27% drug-discovery growth, and a headline $40.7M 'net income'. The Q1 2024 10-Q filed 2024-05-01 — fourteen days BEFORE cutoff — shows total revenue collapsing to -43% YoY (drug discovery -90%, software decelerating to +4%) and loss from operations widening +121% YoY. Two MODERATE Mode B catches: (a) the $40.7M FY2023 net income is mechanically a $147M one-time Nimbus distribution masking a -$177M operating loss that actually WIDENED 21% YoY, and (b) the $100K+ ACV customer cohort contracted YoY (227 -> 222) — the first decline in the disclosed series, but the 'broad adoption' narrative does not foreground it. Customer concentration (16% top, 26% AR, 42%+22% contract assets), the BMS $1.5B headline, and the proprietary clinical pipeline are all honestly disclosed at the contract/note level. Auditor, material-weakness remediation, and going-concern all PASS. No open-market insider buying during the drawdown. Verdict: SHORT-tier — the headline FY2023 growth/profit narrative is invalidated by the company's own pre-cutoff Q1 2024 print.
